question: What proclaimed title identifies this ritual practice and its power over the three worlds?
premises: The subject is this ritual practice.
The practice is declared with a specific name.
The name signifies bewildering the three worlds.
inference: This practice is proclaimed as Trailokyamohana, the bewilderer of the three worlds.
plain_english: This practice is declared by the name Trailokyamohana, the bewilderer of the three worlds.
